cmd:archive.note: archives the open session after a confirm dialog

cmd:commands.note: opens the command palette; it lists desktop actions, and : queries run TUI commands

cmd:kill.note: soft interrupt of the open session

cmd:pause-clear.note: clears the operator pause of the open session

global:backspace/command-line.note: : command line deletes the last character

global:char/command-line.note: : command line appends the typed character

global:enter/command-line.note: : command line runs the ex command

key:<Space>a.note: archive with a confirm dialog; also Session menu, right-click, Archive button

key:<Space>c.note: sends "continue" to the open session; also Session menu, right-click

key:<Space>hc.note: clear pause after a second press within 5 s; also Session menu, right-click, Clear pause button

key:Ctrl-N.note: launch dialog; Cmd-N on macOS; File > New session…, New session button

key:Enter.note: opens the session under the list cursor (Go menu, palette)

key:L.note: opens the session under the list cursor (Go menu, palette)

key:X.note: hard pause after a second press within 5 s; also Session menu, right-click, Hard pause button

key:[a.note: previous session needing you (Go menu, palette)

key:]a.note: next session needing you (Go menu, palette)

key:l.note: opens the session under the list cursor (Go menu, palette)

key:x.note: soft interrupt; every surface runs the same registry action (src/registry.ts): key, palette, menu bar, right-click, Interrupt button

module:ui/content.rs.note: event content: Markdown through the sanitizing backend with fenced code blocks coloured by language (G4), tool / thinking collapse, blob elision, long-message folds

module:ui/overlay/command_palette.rs.note: the palette over the desktop action registry; see overlay-ref:command-palette

module:ui/session.rs.note: the TUI's session pane is drawn cell by cell; the desktop's is an HTML header (status, model, pending messages, markers), the transcript and the message box, each listed under its own feature rows

overlay-ref:command-palette.note: typing filters, Backspace, Down / Ctrl-N and Up / Ctrl-P move, Tab puts the highlighted action's : command on the line to edit its argument, Enter runs, Esc leaves the argument edit first and then closes; : queries run TUI command lines

overlay:prompt-overlay-new-session-conti.location: src/prompts.ts, src/prompt-model.ts, src/launch.ts, src-tauri/src/prompts.rs, src/actions/detail.ts, src/actions/input.ts
overlay:prompt-overlay-new-session-conti.note: the New session and continue prompts with the TUI's modes (G1's vim editor and NORMAL / INSERT badge), contextual help on ?, the launch header row, the settings side with a manager appointment, compile / grammar / AI helpers, paste with image references and the modal geometry keys (G1). Substitute: one New session dialog, no stacked prompts, tabs or splits (see overlay-ref:new-session-prompt), and the grant page is the full policy editor (see overlay-ref:new-session-settings)

section:quit.note: ZQ, ZZ, :quit, and the OS Quit menu item
